name: gitlab
description: Operate GitLab workflows, analyze CI, enforce MR approval scope binding, and securely provision a dedicated Windows project Runner from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Operate GitLab and provision isolated Windows Runners
interface.longDescription: Use GitLab from Codex through a local MCP server backed by the GitLab REST API. It supports project discovery, merge request and issue inspection, sanitized approval and CI analysis, a CI_JOB_TOKEN MR approval/scope gate, discussions, comments, approvals, merge actions, decoded API calls, policy-bound atomic provisioning of a dedicated Windows project Runner, and a verified one-click Windows bootstrap without exposing its one-time authentication token.
